verses.gurmukhi: ਲਹੁੜਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lahuRaa til hoi ja(n)miaa neechahu neech na aap ganaiaa|

en.bdb: Small sesame seeds sprouted and it remained lowly and got itself not mentioned anywhere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫੁਲਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਗੰਧੁ ਸੁਗੰਧੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: fulaa sa(n)gat vasiaa hoi niraga(n)dh suga(n)dh suhaiaa|

en.bdb: When it came to the company of flowers, it earlier being devoid of fragrance now become fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਲੂ ਪਾਇ ਪੀੜਾਇਆ ਹੋਇ ਫੁਲੇਲੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: koloo pai peeRaiaa hoi fulel khel varataiaa|

en.bdb: When alongwith flowers it was crushed in crusher, it became perfume oil.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਲਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: patit pavitr chalitr kar patisaeh sir dhar sukh paiaa|

en.bdb: God, the purifier of the impure ones, enacted such a wondrous feat that that fragrant oil gave  pleasure to the king when messaged on his head.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਵੈ ਪਾਇ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਕੁਲ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dheevai pai jalaiaa kul dheepak jag biradh sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: When it was burnt in the lamp it came to be known as kuldipak, the lamp of the dynasty generally lit to complete the last rites of man.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਜਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਦੀਵਿਅਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kajal hoaa dheeviahu akhee a(n)dhar jai samaiaa|

en.bdb: From lamp becoming collyrium it merged in the eyes.
It became great but never allowed itself to be called so.
